environment.description: ECS Fargate service in identical VPC topology. CloudHSM cluster with non-extractable keys (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=FALSE, CKA_WRAP_WITH_TRUSTED=TRUE). Task execution role scoped with permission boundary arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/PB-NoExternalNetworkCalls that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface outside the VPC CIDR. ALB has AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with rule group reference statement using 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' (priority 1) with SizeConstraint override on query string parameters limiting to 64 bytes, plus a custom regex pattern set rule (priority 0) that blocks any query string matching '\{\{|\{%|__[a-z]' with action BLOCK. CloudWatch contributor insights enabled on WAF logs. Task network mode awsvpc with VPC endpoint policies restricting egress to S3 and CloudWatch only via PrivateLink.

config.alb_config: internet-facing, TLS termination, WAFv2 WebACL associated
config.security_groups: ALB: inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0; Task: inbound 8443/tcp from ALB SG only
config.vpc_endpoints: S3 gateway endpoint, CloudWatch Logs interface endpoint only
config.egress_policy: No NAT gateway, no internet gateway route for task subnets
